- Supportive care for probable gastroenteritis: increase oral fluid intake to prevent dehydration  
- Monitor for fever or worsening symptoms; if symptoms worsen or fever develops, seek in-person evaluation  
- Avoid unnecessary antibiotics as they are generally not helpful for viral gastroenteritis  
- Patient advised to rest and stay home until improvement  
- Follow-up through primary care provider recommended if no improvement after short observation period or if symptoms worsen
